rationale: Braking behavior itself must be characterised to evaluate prevention of unintended braking. H-3 identifies sudden stopping without an obstacle as the hazardous event, SG-3 requires prevention of unintended braking, and FR-7 establishes collision avoidance with obstacles as an intended purpose of braking. P captures this relationship within the supplied operational situation without incorporating sensing, computation, communication, failure-mitigation mechanisms, or their timing constraints.
determining_elements: “Vehicle braking behavior,” including “whether braking occurs,” directly addresses the behavior targeted by SG-3 and H-3.
“Whether it is justified by an obstacle or collision-avoidance need” connects braking to the environmental justification established by H-3 and FR-7.
The declared scope matches H-3: straight-ahead driving on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h, in good weather, with no visible obstacles or vehicles ahead.
